Kobool can't function properly without "Cookies" enabled.
To enable "Cookies" follow these steps:
- Open "Tools" menu.
- Open Internet Options..
- Open "Privacy" tab.
- Click on "Default" button.
- Click OK.
- Refresh the current page by pressing F5 key.

error.blacklist_member:
This profile can not be re-activated because the owner has violated the rules of Kobool site and ignored the warnings of the supervisors.

If you are already in connection with another member via Kobool Acceptance Matching you still have the following options:

  • Your profile will remain visible to that member.
  • You will be able to continue communicating with that member.
  • You can use Kobool Contact Card to chat with that member.

    However, you have the following limitations:

  • If you update any text or question answer in your profile it will not be reviewed by Kobool supervisors and will remain (under review) forever.
  • If you (or the person currently connected to you) decline from this relationship you will not participate in future Kobool Acceptance Matching and there is no chance to be matched with other members.
